name: @lulux/desktop
description: LULUX ETA (LULUX External Trade Agent) desktop shell
author: koko <kokozenshii0308@gmail.com>

scripts.predist: npm run build && npm run bundle:server && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('node_modules',{recursive:true})"
scripts.dist:win: npm run predist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run predist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run predist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never
